data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Attractions, type destination and pick the suggestion, select date, Search, optional filter, open attraction, check availability) in the right order with destination and date as parameters. It adds a sort_option parameter and a final ticket/Next step, and it omits a guests parameter, but a browser automation could still be built from the spec.
